summary: Implement canonical provider-neutral PIM/MDM masters, typed Product master-data assignments, field-level source authority, explainable duplicate candidates, deterministic non-executing merge previews, additive external mapping v3, and atomic audit/outbox/lineage evidence.

impacts.evidence: All PIM masters, assignments, authority rules and review evidence are organization/workspace scoped with composite tenant foreign keys, transaction-local scope and forced RLS.
PIM stores bounded business master data and review explanations; it does not copy credentials or customer PII. Decimal attribute values use exact string representation and review evidence is bounded.
New additive Draft 2020-12 PIM contracts and connector-mapping v3 are introduced. Existing Product/Offer and connector mapping v1/v2 shapes remain unchanged.
A new commerce.pim.record_changed.v1 event is registered. Existing catalog/order/pricing/inventory event payloads are not modified.
The generic connector identity bridge is additively broadened to brand/category/attribute. No provider name or taxonomy field is added to Core and Connector SDK v1 root interfaces remain unchanged.
Expand migration 000015 creates canonical PIM/MDM tables and broadens the connector mapping type constraint/guard without dropping or renaming existing data columns.
Forced RLS, same-tenant foreign keys, immutable identities/types, no hard delete/truncate and exact typed-attribute validation fail closed against cross-tenant/provider-specific contamination.
Task 023 creates merge previews only and does not execute destructive merges. Sensitive merge/publication actions remain gated by Task 017 approval.
PIM mutations append Task-003 Audit, Task-008 Outbox and Task-030 Lineage evidence atomically; merge/duplicate provenance references source IDs and versions instead of copying provider payloads.
Optimistic versions, generic external mappings, deterministic preview fingerprints and immutable duplicate evidence create the canonical identity/decision inputs for Tasks 013/014.
Task 023 performs no outbound webhook/network delivery. Task 063 remains responsible for durable webhook egress.
Versioned PIM events, duplicate scores/signals and merge conflict counts provide bounded operational metrics and explainable support evidence.
The migration is additive; binary rollback retains PIM masters and review evidence. Backup/restore rehearsal must preserve the new tables and RLS boundaries.
Tests cover typed master validation, deterministic authority-based merge preview, explainable duplicates, migration/RLS/provider-neutral guards, and executable Task-023 static audits.
